API Reference

Complete API reference for the Deep Research Engine.

Main Entry Points

run_workflow()

Main entry point for executing workflows.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from deep_research_engine import run_workflow, load_config

config = load_config("configs/rag.yaml")

async for event in run_workflow(
    query="What is quantum computing?",
    config=config,
    stream=True,
):
    print(event)

Parameters:

  • arrow_forwardquery (str): Research query or input
  • arrow_forwardconfig (WorkflowConfig): Loaded workflow configuration
  • arrow_forwardstream (bool, optional): Enable streaming events. Default: True
  • arrow_forward**kwargs: Additional workflow-specific parameters

Returns:

  • arrow_forwardAsyncGenerator yielding event dictionaries

Event Types:

  • arrow_forwardphase_start - Phase beginning
  • arrow_forwardphase_complete - Phase completed
  • arrow_forwardworker_complete - Worker finished
  • arrow_forwardcritic_decision - Critic evaluation result
  • arrow_forwardsynthesis_complete - Final output ready
  • arrow_forwarderror - Error occurred
architecture

Load and validate workflow configuration from YAML.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG

config = load_config("configs/rag.yaml")

Parameters:

Returns:

  • arrow_forwardWorkflowConfig: Validated configuration object

Raises:

  • arrow_forwardConfigNotFoundError: Config file not found
  • arrow_forwardConfigValidationError: Invalid configuration
  • arrow_forwardConfigError: General configuration error

Workers

BaseWorker

Abstract base class for all workers.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from deep_research_engine.workers import BaseWorker, WorkerRegistry

@WorkerRegistry.register("my_worker")
class MyWorker(BaseWorker):
    worker_type = "my_worker"
    description = "My custom worker"
    
    async def execute(self, state, config) -> WorkerResult:
        self._start_timing()
        try:
            result = await self.do_work()
            return self._create_result(success=True, output=result)
        except Exception as e:
            return self._create_result(success=False, error=str(e))

Methods:

  • arrow_forwardexecute(state, config) -> WorkerResult: Abstract method to implement
  • arrow_forward_start_timing(): Start execution timing
  • arrow_forward_create_result(...): Create standardized result
  • arrow_forward_retry(state, config) -> WorkerResult: Retry execution
architecture

WorkerConfig

Configuration passed to workers.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from deep_research_engine.workers import WorkerConfig

config = WorkerConfig(
    worker_id="web_researcher_0",
    worker_type="web_researcher",
    task="Research quantum computing",
    tools=["web_search", "web_get"],
    max_retries=3,
    timeout=300,
    enable_critic=True,
    critic_threshold=0.7,
    custom={"key": "value"}
)

Fields:

  • arrow_forwardworker_id (str): Unique identifier
  • arrow_forwardworker_type (str): Worker type
  • arrow_forwardtask (any): Task to execute
  • arrow_forwardtools (list[str]): Available tools
  • arrow_forwardmax_retries (int): Maximum retry attempts
  • arrow_forwardtimeout (int): Timeout in seconds
  • arrow_forwardenable_critic (bool): Enable critic evaluation
  • arrow_forwardcritic_threshold (float): Quality threshold
  • arrow_forwardcustom (dict): Custom configuration

WorkerRegistry

Worker registration and discovery.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from deep_research_engine.workers import WorkerRegistry

# Register worker
@WorkerRegistry.register("my_worker")
class MyWorker(BaseWorker):
    ...

# Get worker class
WorkerClass = WorkerRegistry.get("my_worker")

# Check if registered
if WorkerRegistry.is_registered("my_worker"):
    ...

# List all workers
for name, cls in WorkerRegistry.list_all():
    print(f"{name}: {cls.description}")

Methods:

  • arrow_forwardregister(name): Decorator to register worker
  • arrow_forwardget(name): Get worker class by name
  • arrow_forwardis_registered(name): Check if worker is registered
  • arrow_forwardlist_all(): List all registered workers

Storage

StorageManager

Central orchestrator for storage backends.

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from deep_research_engine.storage import StorageManager

storage = StorageManager()

await storage.initialize("postgres", {
    "connection": "postgresql://localhost:5433/deep_research",
    "vector_index": "research"
})

result = await storage.store(data, namespace="research")
data = await storage.retrieve(result.id, namespace="research")
results = await storage.query("machine learning", namespace="research", limit=10)

await storage.cleanup()

Methods:

  • arrow_forwardinitialize(backend, config): Initialize backend
  • arrow_forwardget_backend(name): Get backend instance
  • arrow_forwardstore(data, namespace): Store data
  • arrow_forwardretrieve(id, namespace): Retrieve data
  • arrow_forwardquery(query, namespace, limit): Query data
  • arrow_forwardcleanup(): Cleanup all backends
architecture

Errors

Config Errors

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from deep_research_engine.errors import (
    ConfigError,
    ConfigNotFoundError,
    ConfigValidationError
)

try:
    config = load_config("invalid.yaml")
except ConfigNotFoundError:
    print("Config file not found")
except ConfigValidationError as e:
    print(f"Invalid config: {e}")
except ConfigError as e:
    print(f"Config error: {e}")
